reason: The analyst controls for collab_index_2023, a post-treatment variable (a mediator or collider) that correlates strongly with remote_share. That produces a biased estimate of -2.7 and a 'negative effect' conclusion. With pre-treatment controls only, my own analysis gives about -0.28 (p≈0.25), which is no detectable effect. The analyst also reports a single specification and trims the outcome without justification.
